lines.text: A Model for Determining Evacuation Routes
Summary
In 2018, the number of people in the Louvre was 10.8 million, creating a new high. At the
same time, in the event of an emergency, such a large number of tourists will increase the
difficulty of evacuation and raise the risk. Therefore, our goal is to design the Louvre's
emergency evacuation plan to evacuate visitors from the museum and estimate the
evacuation time, while also allowing emergency personnel to enter the building as quickly

spans.text: as possible, as well as considering other factors and potential threats

lines.text: as possible, as well as considering other factors and potential threats.

The third model uses the improved Dijkstra algorithm. The model considers the entire
